t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

t: The Twilight Zone: Static
d: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
d: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
d: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
d: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

t: The Twilight Zone: Shadow Play
d: Adam Grant is trapped in a recurring nightmare, in which he is sentenced to death and executed.

t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
d: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

t: Stir of Echoes
d: After being hypnotized, Tom (Kevin Bacon) is haunted by terrifying visions that seem to be sending him a message from beyond.

t: A Lizard in a Woman's Skin
d: Den litt ustabile datteren til en britisk politiker blir anklaget for å ha drept sin livsnyter av en nabo – etter å ha sett drapet i en drøm.

t: The Jolly Monkey
d: For 40 år siden forsvant familier i nærheten av det isolerte Jolly Monkey-motellet. I dag vender eiernes familie tilbake for å diskutere hva de skal gjøre med stedet. Én etter én blir de drept av noen utkledd som motellets maskot og må flykte.

t: Scary Movie 2
d: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
d: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

t: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
d: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
d: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins
d: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

t: Scary Movie 2
d: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

t: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
d: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

t: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
d: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

t: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

t: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
d: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
d: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.
